A gentle rhythm, not another task

Lampada accompanies personal Christian prayer from the first intention to a closing reflection. It supports your attention without replacing your own words.

01

Pray with focus

Set a topic and a comfortable duration. Guiding questions help you stay present and move deeper.

02

Meet Scripture in context

Lampada selects Scripture passages by meaning, so the reading can speak to the prayer you are living today.

03

Return to what mattered

Keep text or voice reflections, a final takeaway, and saved verses in a private journal on your device.

A warm, distraction-free space with optional quiet music, a prayer timer, and gentle reminders to return.
